_what_this_is: the probes A18 runs. Each one names a place where the record and reality can diverge, and how to tell. Adding an installation means adding probes, not changing code.

_the_two_directions.backward: recorded rows that never became real — simulations, reversals, parked documents
_the_two_directions.forward: configured entries that never produce a document — designed but dormant

backward._why: THE ONE THAT COST NINE TIMES. Payroll posting runs write documents whether or not they are real; only reaching FI distinguishes them.

coverage_guard._why: bkpf in the golden covers 2024-2026 only. Outside that window every payroll run looks like a simulation and is not.

backward._why: FM commitments can be reduced to zero and still sit in the table. A commitment with no remaining amount is a record of something that has finished, not something that is.

forward._why: THE MIRROR ERROR. 72 Constant Dollar wage types, all configured, all identical, described as the mechanism. Zero of them post.
a symbolic account configured for posting that no payroll item ever uses is capacity nobody is exercising.
